description: As a ground operations supervisor, I want to export scan history for a flight's baggage so that I can generate compliance reports.

acs.text: Export button generates a CSV file with all scan events for the selected flight.
CSV includes columns: bag_tag, scan_location, scan_time, handler_id, status.
Export is available only after flight departure (status = departed or arrived).

sections.content: Backend: Python 3.11, Django. Staging URL: https://staging.bagtrack.internal. Test data seeded nightly. Azure DevOps for CI/CD. Manual QA execution — no automated test suite in place.
